meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进计划执行,并行调度多个子代理完成工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你制定好计划后希望一键执行并分派给子代理
copy.tagline_en: Execute your plan and orchestrate parallel subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want to execute it with subagents.

howto.what: 你不再自己写代码或改文件，而是作为总指挥：把每个实现、测试、审查任务派给子代理，并行推进，同时维护计划勾选、Boulder 状态和证据记录，直到计划全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说“开始工作”“执行计划”“继续计划”等，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发。

say.text: 开始执行 .omo/plans 里的计划
say.note: 它会先选定计划，然后派子代理开始干活。
它会从下一个未完成的勾选任务继续。
它会用独立工作分支，完成后提交 PR。

howto.what_en: You no longer write code or edit files. As orchestrator, you delegate every implementation/test/QA/review task to spawned subagents, run independent lanes in parallel, and maintain plan checkboxes, Boulder state, and evidence until the whole plan completes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'start work', 'execute plan', 'continue plan', 'resume plan', or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.note: It picks the plan and spawns workers.
It resumes from the next unchecked task.

say_en.text: Run the plan and open a PR
say_en.note: It uses a separate worktree and hands off a PR.
